name: SMG Suno Studio Pro
title_kh: SMG Suno Studio Pro v2.4.0 — ស្ទូឌីយោ Pro Mastering, Suno Audio Fixer, Live A/B Monitor និង Parametric EQ
title_en: SMG Suno Studio Pro v2.4.0 — Pro Mastering Studio, Suno AI Audio Fixer, Live A/B Monitor & FL Parametric EQ
changelog_kh: 🎛️ បន្ថែមផ្ទាំងទី ៧ Pro Mastering Studio & Suno Audio Fixer (Ctrl+7) ស្ទូឌីយោ DAW ពេញលេញ គ្មាន Logo ជាមួយ FL-Style 6-Band Parametric EQ, De-AI Filter និង 4x True-Peak Brickwall Limiter
🎧 ប្រព័ន្ធ Live A/B Monitor ប្តូរភ្លាមៗរវាងសម្លេងដើម [A: Original Suno] និងសម្លេងសម្រួលរួច [B: Mastered Pro] គ្មាន latency ជាមួយ Stereo L/R Peak Meters
🤖 មុខងារ AI Artifact Scanner រកឃើញសំឡេងរញ៉េរញ៉ៃ (Boxy Mud 200-500Hz, Robotic Harshness 6k-10kHz, Inter-sample Clipping) ព្រមទាំង Auto Title AI បង្កើតចំណងជើងតាម Key/BPM/Vibe
🌉 ស្ពានភ្ជាប់ 1-Click Studio Ecosystem: ទាញយកពី Suno Downloader ឬ Suno Browser ចូល Mastering Studio ភ្លាមៗ និង Export ចូល Lyric Editor Stem Player
🛡️ Hardened Installer & Standalone EXE: គាំទ្រ 64-bit NumPy Offline DSP គ្មានការពឹងផ្អែកលើ Scipy/Heavy ML ធានាដំណើរការរលូនគ្មាន Error លើគ្រប់ Windows 10/11 PC
changelog_en: 🎛️ Added 7th Studio Mode: Pro Mastering Studio & Suno Audio Fixer (Ctrl+7) clean logo-free pro DAW with FL-style 6-band Parametric EQ, De-AI notch filters, Mid-Side expander, and 4x True-Peak Brickwall Limiter
🎧 Zero-latency Live A/B Monitor: Instant one-click toggle between [A: Original Suno] and [B: Mastered Pro] with dual vertical L/R dBFS peak meters and antialiased interactive waveform editor
🤖 Suno AI Artifact Scanner & Auto Title AI: Auto-detects 200-500Hz boxy mud, 6k-10kHz robotic phase smear, inter-sample clipping, and generates 5 musical key/tempo/vibe song titles
🌉 1-Click Studio Ecosystem Bridges: Direct handoff from Suno Downloader and Suno Browser into Mastering Studio, and 1-click export to Lyric Editor Stem Player
🛡️ Hardened Installer & Standalone EXE: Pure 64-bit NumPy vectorized offline DSP without SciPy dependencies, ensuring flawless execution on all Windows 10/11 (x64) PCs
